author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The ESP-FLY DIY Kit is a compact micro drone platform built around the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3, developed as a collaboration between Seeed Studio and Max Imagination. The kit targets educational and hobbyist use, combining a small airframe with wireless control options and a customizable firmware environment. The system is delivered as a DIY kit […]
title: ESP-FLY micro drone kit offers ESP32-S3-based flight control and ESP-NOW support
